verdict.rationale: Cline documents coordinated multi-file changes in one task, and its Kanban board runs many agents in parallel across tasks. Together these approximate operating on many items at once. However, no feature is documented for applying a single operation across a selected set of items. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch operation capability (one instruction applied over a defined set of items), documented limits or scale of multi-file edits, and hands-on corroboration of bulk use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Coordinated multi-file changes with linter-aware fixes, diffs, checkpoints, and one-click undo on every step.
Run many agents in parallel from a web-based task board with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains.
Use Cline Kanban to run multiple coding agents in parallel with isolated git worktrees.
